name: smwsprites-birdfish
title: Birdfish
description:
This little guy from Super Mario Land 2 acts similarly to the vanilla jumping fish, but it always alternates one dive in water and one jump in the air. Additionally, it will hover for a bit when at the peak of the jump. Check out the asm file for configuration options such as speed, acceleration and hover time.
Included also a generator that acts similarly to the vanilla jumping fish generator.
Graphics provided by idol.
